predecessor_anchor_note: Phase 0 has no predecessor envelope. predecessor_envelope_sha256 is the file-bytes SHA-256 of HANDOFF_CRYPTO_PROTOCOL.md (the bootstrap root per crypto protocol § 5.2 / § 13).
notes: Phase 0 envelope. Seals 9 content deliverables + governance trio + addendum + crypto protocol. handoff_md_sha256 is PENDING because HANDOFF_phase_0.md is written AFTER the sealing ceremony completes and the seal verifies (per addendum § 16 #13). After the ceremony, this script is re-run to inject handoff_md_sha256, then the envelope is re-signed.
